examined_formations.title: MUNICIPAL_SHORT_TERM_RENTAL_COMPLIANCE_MONITORING
buyer_non_role_spend_evidence: A current 2026 municipal RFP seeks short-term-rental compliance services for an initial three-year term with two optional one-year extensions and requires implementation plus annual subscription/support pricing.

The buyer states that it already uses Host Compliance, now owned by Granicus, so the signal is a direct buyer-side recurring procurement/replacement event rather than a job posting or seller price page.
examined_formations.formation_frame: Listings, permit status, tax obligations and complaint activity repeatedly regenerate local short-term-rental compliance state.
examined_formations.exact_incumbent_preflight: Granicus Host Compliance already identifies listings across major rental sites, supports permit/tax workflows, monitors compliance, automates outreach and offers 24/7 complaint handling as one current municipal control surface.

examined_formations.title: WORKERS_COMP_MEDICAL_BILL_REVIEW
buyer_non_role_spend_evidence: A current 2026 public-sector procurement seeks workers-compensation medical-bill review for an initial October 2026 through September 2029 term with up to two one-year renewals.

The scope includes bill review, fee-schedule compliance, high-dollar or suspected-inappropriate-care review and recurring savings reporting, establishing repeat buyer-side spend rather than stated interest.
examined_formations.formation_frame: Each workers-compensation medical bill regenerates pricing, fee-schedule, coding and medical-appropriateness review state before payment.
examined_formations.exact_incumbent_preflight: Enlyte currently sells an integrated workers-compensation bill-review and cost-containment suite and states that a large majority of bill processing is automated while fee schedules and related controls are maintained inside the service.

examined_formations.title: PARKING_CITATION_PROCESSING_AND_ADJUDICATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 停车罚单处理与裁决运营
buyer_non_role_spend_evidence: South San Francisco approved a 2026 extension with Turbo Data Systems for parking citation processing, adjudication support, traffic-citation processing and related issuance equipment through March 31, 2027.
The nine-month extension is capped at $56,250, providing explicit current buyer-side recurring contract spend.
examined_formations.formation_frame: Every issued citation creates payment, notice, contest, adjudication and collection state that must be processed through a government-controlled lifecycle.
examined_formations.exact_incumbent_preflight: Turbo Data Systems already provides one-stop citation management including parking citation processing, web payment, communications, permit and related municipal workflows.

examined_formations.title: MUNICIPAL_HOTEL_OCCUPANCY_AND_SALES_TAX_ADMINISTRATION

buyer_non_role_spend_evidence: A September 2026 City of Weslaco contract record shows renewal of MuniServices tax-administration agreements covering hotel-occupancy and sales-tax audit/administration.
This is a direct public-buyer renewal signal for recurring tax administration and audit work, not a role posting.
examined_formations.formation_frame: Recurring merchant receipts, remittances, jurisdiction rules and filing periods regenerate municipal tax-administration and compliance-review state.
examined_formations.exact_incumbent_preflight: MuniServices/Avenu already operates mature local-government tax-administration, payment and compliance-audit offerings, combining software with experienced tax examiners and audit services.

examined_formations.title: FOIA_PUBLIC_RECORD_REQUEST_REVIEW_AND_REDACTION
examined_formations.chinese_title: FOIA 公共记录请求审查与脱敏
buyer_non_role_spend_evidence: A current 2026 federal procurement renews AINS eFOIAXpress software for a one-year term and describes automated redaction of sensitive information across documents, audio and video.
A separate 2026 county procurement recommends JustFOIA as a countywide public-records platform with an annually renewing subscription, confirming independent buyer-side recurring software spend.
examined_formations.formation_frame: Each public-records request regenerates intake, search, deduplication, review, exemption, redaction, approval, billing and release state.

examined_formations.title: MANAGED_DETECTION_AND_RESPONSE_SUBSCRIPTION

The same record states a cumulative contract value of $364,753.78 since March 2024, making repeated external money motion explicit.
examined_formations.formation_frame: Continuous endpoint, network, identity and cloud telemetry regenerates security-alert, investigation and response state around the clock.
